Functions (slides)

These are the functions used in my slides:

Clean Data

clean_text <- function(data, text) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      text_clean = {{ text }} |>
        str_to_lower() |>
        str_replace_all("<br\\s*/?>", " ") |>
        str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9\\s]", " ") |>
        str_squish()
    )
}

Tokenize Text

tokenize_text <- function(data) {
  data |>
    unnest_tokens(word, text_clean) |>
    anti_join(stop_words, by = "word")
}

Term Frequencies

term_frequencies <- function(data) {
  data |>
    count(word, sort = TRUE) 
}

Sentiment Analysis

sentiment_wordcloud <- function(data, lexicon = "bing") {
  data |>
    inner_join(get_sentiments(lexicon), by = "word") |>
    count(word, sentiment) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = sentiment, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    column_to_rownames("word") |>
    as.matrix() |>
    comparison.cloud(colors = c("#C0392B", "#2E7D32"))
}

Prepare Data for Model

stm_data <- function(data) {
  dtm <- data |>
    count(row_id, word) |>
    cast_sparse(row_id, word, n)

  readCorpus(
    as.matrix(dtm),
    type = "dtm"
  )
}

Choosing K

search_topics <- function(stm_data, k = 2:10) {
  searchK(
    documents = stm_data$documents,
    vocab = stm_data$vocab,
    K = k
  )
}

Topic Model

model_data <- function(preped_data, k = 8) {
  stm(
    documents = preped_data$documents,
    vocab = preped_data$vocab,
    K = k,
    init.type = "Spectral"
  )
}

Run Code

This is a dry run of all the code without any modifications.

clean_dogville <- clean_text(dogville, review_text)
dogville_tokenize <- tokenize_text(clean_dogville) 
dog_ville_frequencies <- term_frequencies(dogville_tokenize)
dogville_sentiment <- sentiment_wordcloud(dogville_tokenize)
dogville_stm <- stm_data(dogville_tokenize)
dogville_search_k <- search_topics(dogville_stm)
